name: Green Goblin (Stellar Forged)
signatureAbility:
ISO-Forged Oscorp Weaponry
At the start of each fight, inflict a [25 - 60]% Torment Debuff for 30 seconds.
While the Opponent has 5 or more unique Debuffs, the potency of their Willpower Mastery is reduced by [25 - 75]%.

abilitySections.title: A Scientist Forged in ISO - Always Active
content: Green Goblin's Stellar Enhancement grants him a Fractured Power Bar.
Green Goblin does not gain Precision Buffs from the Dexterity Mastery. Avoiding an attack with Dexterity pauses all personal Debuffs on the Opponent for 0.5 seconds per rank.

abilitySections.title: While Fighting as a Defender
content: Green Goblin starts each fight with four 12% Protection Passives for 25 seconds, expiring one at a time. When struck by a Guaranteed Critical Hit, 8 seconds are lost. When Intercepted, 12 seconds are lost.
For each personal Protection active, gain +[239.13] Critical Resistance, Physical Resistance, and Energy Resistance Passives.
Personal Debuffs can be inflicted through Block. Cooldown: 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: While Fighting as an Attacker
content: For each unique Debuff on the Opponent, gain a +[1,173.24] Fury Passive.
Personal Debuffs are paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Basic Attacks
content: Light Attacks pause all personal Debuffs for 0.5 seconds.
Medium Attacks inflict a [305.56] Exhaustion Debuff for 15 seconds. Max stacks: 2.
Heavy Attacks inflict a Halt Debuff for 10 seconds on the first hit, and a non-stacking [7,332.75] Incinerate Debuff for 10 seconds on the second hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Withering Contagion
content: For each unique Debuff on the Opponent, the first five hits each deal a burst of [977.7] Physical Damage. This damage can be dealt through Block.
The final hit inflicts a 50% Wither Debuff for 10 seconds. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Sublimation Through Conflagration
content: For each unique Debuff on the Opponent, the first hit inflicts a [7,332.75] Incinerate Debuff for 10 seconds. Max stacks: 10.
The final hit refreshes all personal Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Bombarded by Science
content: Inflict a personal Wither, Exhaustion, Halt, and Incinerate Debuff, then pause all personal Debuffs for 10 seconds.
